mods.name: Desert Vehicle Reskin — Alpha Vehicles Neolithic
mods.author: Mandrake
mods.description:
Redraws the draught animals in Alpha Vehicles - Neolithic so its carts read as desert, not as medieval Europe.

Mostly texture overrides: every art file here sits at the exact path the donor's own ThingDef already asks for, so the vehicles, their stats and their research stay entirely the donor's, and Alpha Vehicles - Neolithic itself is never edited.

Two things go beyond art. A pair of XML PatchOperations retint and rename the dog sled as an eopie sled, and a small Harmony assembly widens what the draught vehicles will burn: the donor gives each cart exactly one fuel ThingDef (Hay for the chariots, ox cart and covered carriage; Kibble for the sled) because its fuel comp holds a single ThingDef and no ThingFilter, so there is no XML route to widen it. The patch makes any nutrition-giving vegetable-type food count — anything whose foodType carries Plant, VegetableOrFruit or Meal, excluding meat, animal products and drugs — plus, always, whatever the vehicle already declared, so nothing that fuels a cart today stops fuelling it. No defName is listed anywhere, so modded crops qualify on their own.

WHY THE ANIMAL AND NOT THE CART

The draught animals are drawn INTO the vehicle texture rather than spawned as pawns, so replacing them is a per-file art edit. The carts themselves are fine: an ox cart, a covered carriage and a chariot are as at home on a desert world as anywhere. Only what pulls them is off-theme.

Seven of the donor's vehicles are untouched because they have no animal to replace — the wheelbarrow, hwacha, rickshaw and palanquin are human-powered, the balloon is Air, and the row boat and outrigger canoe are Sea.

CONTENTS

  Things/Vehicles/Land/Tier0/DogSled/AV_DogSled_{north,south,east}
      A team of two eopies in place of four dogs. The eopie is Tatooine's
      canonical beast of burden; four dogs at a sled's scale read as a polar
      expedition. Two animals rather than four because the eopie is the larger
      beast — the harness traces are re-routed as a two-animal Y.
      Each facing is drawn, not mirrored: south is a head-on pair abreast,
      north is a rear view with no snout and the rigging hanging down, east is
      a side profile with the pair stacked vertically and the rigging to the
      left.

  Things/Vehicles/Land/Tier0/DogSled/AV_DogSled_{north,south,east}m
      The paired colour masks, edited in step with the art. Vehicle Framework
      reads these for its colour and pattern system, so a mask left stale
      makes the new animal refuse to tint. Note the donor's suffix convention:
      the "m" is appended to the facing (AV_DogSled_southm), not separated
      (AV_DogSled_south_m).

LOAD ORDER MATTERS HERE

Alpha Vehicles - Neolithic ships its vehicle art as loose PNGs, not as an AssetBundle. Between two loose files at the same path RimWorld resolves by load order, so this mod must load AFTER the donor or the donor's own art wins and nothing here is visible. That is the opposite of an AssetBundle override, where a loose file wins regardless of order.

physical laws instead of RimWorld's defaults.

The problem it fixes, measured on this exact mod set: the median ranged weapon
did 12 damage and the median BLASTER did 10 — against a human fist at 8.2. Four
in five weapons needed three or more hits to drop an unarmoured person, a wooden
club outperformed a blaster rifle, and a turbolaser did 80, only 1.45x a vanilla
sniper turret. Everything from fist to capital battery lived inside a 10x range.

  heavy blaster       -> 52-72    deliberately breaks the 5-shot contract
  slugthrower         -> 18-36    spread wide; the answer to desert megafauna
  vibro               -> 35-52    the anti-ablative counter

  turbolaser          -> 800-2000 two orders above personal weapons

keep their near-zero damage. The verb IS the weapon — an ion gun that kills is
just a worse blaster. Explosives are untouched too: blast has no hard counter,
so it is balanced by scarcity alone.

ladder, it does not flatten it.

mods.description:
BACTA_TANK_CORE_1 — the bacta tank and the fluid that fills it.

Bacta is not regeneration. It is healing, turned up: a pawn suspended in a powered, filled tank closes wounds and burns far faster than a hospital bed, and — given long enough — old scars and permanent physical injuries fade out entirely. Damaged organs mend. What bacta will NOT do is grow anything back: a missing kidney stays missing, a lost leg stays lost. It will not touch the brain, and it will not repair a mind.

Infections are helped only where medicine could have helped them. An untendable disease runs its course in the tank exactly as it would in a bed.

The point is the shape of a lost battle. Without bacta, a bad raid costs colonists. With it, a bad raid costs recovery time — pawns are out of the game while they float, and they come back.

Bacta itself cannot be made. It is bought from exotic and outlander traders, or taken off someone who had some. The tank drinks it while it works, and stops when the tank runs dry.

Off by default, in Mod Settings: revival of the recently dead. A fresh corpse of ours, retrieved within a tunable window of a few hours, can be carried into an empty tank and revived — minus whatever bacta can't fix. No missing part regrows, and the brain and mind are untouched either way.

No Harmony patches: the tank is a Building_Enterable with our own ThingComps, so nothing in the base game is rewritten.

mods.name: Bandolier North Fix — Star Wars KotOR Resources and Materials
mods.author: Mandrake
mods.description:
Adds the missing north-facing worn art for two of the four bandoliers in Star Wars KotOR Resources and Materials: bandolier_chewbacca and bandolier_traveler.

WHAT THE PLAYER SEES WITHOUT IT — worse than a missing bandolier

The bandolier does not vanish when a pawn turns its back. RimWorld's Graphic_Multi, finding no north texture, fills the slot from the south at 180 degrees, so the pawn gets its CHEST POUCHES DRAWN ON ITS BACK — and the def's own drawData puts the north view at layer 65, on top of everything else the pawn is wearing. Wrong art rather than absent art, which is why it reads as intentional and nobody reports it.

No log line is possible. "Failed to find any textures at" fires only when EVERY direction of a set is missing, and these sets have east and south.

Both items carry wide generation tags — chewbacca on KotORAccessory_any / heavy / outlaw / trooper / bandolier, traveler adding civilian and richcivilian — so they land on colonists, traders and raiders alike, and north is roughly one facing in four. This is the most-seen missing-facing defect we have found in this mod set.

CONTENTS — 20 files

  SWApparel/Accessories/bandolier_chewbacca/Apparel_{Male,Female,Thin,Fat,Hulk}_north
  SWApparel/Accessories/bandolier_chewbacca/Apparel_{Male,Female,Thin,Fat,Hulk}_northm
  SWApparel/Accessories/bandolier_traveler/Apparel_{Male,Female,Thin,Fat,Hulk}_north
  SWApparel/Accessories/bandolier_traveler/Apparel_{Male,Female,Thin,Fat,Hulk}_northm

      All 512x512, the canvas of every other file in both sets. Ten art files and
      ten tint masks. A complete set here is 32 files and each of these two ships
      22, missing north and northm for all five body types.

      THE DONOR'S ORIGINALS: there are none. Neither north nor northm exists at
      any load folder for either set. The other two bandoliers in the same folder
      — bandolier_double and bandolier_knife — ship north for all five body types
      and are healthy.

HOW THE ART WAS DERIVED — from the author's own finished work, not invented

Nothing here is a fresh drawing. The two complete sets in the same folder are the
specification, and they were measured rather than eyeballed:

  1. NORTH IS A MIRROR. bandolier_knife's north agrees with its own MIRRORED
     south 77.4% by silhouette, and with its unmirrored south only 34.3%. A strap
     worn over one shoulder swaps sides when you walk round the pawn.
     bandolier_double is an X-cross and scores 96% either way, so it neither
     confirms nor denies — the knife decides it.

  2. THE BACK OF A BANDOLIER IS BARE LEATHER. Both of the author's north views
     are the strap with its front furniture gone: his bandolier_double north is
     the X-cross without the pouch blocks his south carries, and his
     bandolier_knife north is the strap and belt without the three sheathed
     knives. Pouches hang on the chest.

  3. HIS MASK SAYS WHICH PIXELS ARE FURNITURE, so that step is not guesswork.
     CutoutComplex tints mask-RED by the apparel's stuff colour and leaves
     mask-BLACK fixed, and in both target sets the mask-black regions are exactly
     the ammo cells and the buckle while the mask-red is the leather and the hip
     pouch. The author drew the split himself; we read it.

  4. THE LEATHER COLOUR IS HIS TOO. It is sampled from the strap pixels his own
     mask calls red — the gaps between his ammo cells, which is the only place
     the bare leather of THIS bandolier is visible anywhere in the set — then
     quantised into five stops and laid across the band, darkest at the edge and
     lightest at the core, which is how he shades every strap in the folder.

  5. THE MASKS ARE A SOLID RED FIELD, because after step 4 there is no
     fixed-colour furniture left on this facing for a mask to protect. That
     matches the author: his own Apparel_*_northm.png files are a solid red
     field, shipped at 16x16. Ours are the same field at the art's own 512x512,
     where the file cannot be mistaken for a truncated one.

  The generator is shipped in Source/build_north.py, with the two survey scripts
  that produced the measurements above (Source/survey_donor_north.py,
  Source/survey_broken_sets.py) and the test that rejected the first recipe
  (Source/test_mask_recipe.py).

WHY IT IS A REPAINT AND NOT AN INPAINT — the attempt that was thrown away

The obvious build is "delete the mask-black furniture, then grow the neighbouring
pixels back over the holes". It was written, run, and rejected on sight. On
bandolier_chewbacca the ammo cells cover 42% of the strap, so what grows back
into the holes is not leather but the shadow gaps BETWEEN cells, and the result
reads as a chewed, mottled band. There is no clean strap surface anywhere in the

mods.description:
Adds the missing north-facing art of the MSE-6 repair droid in Outer Rim - Droid Depot.

The droid's PawnKindDef declares Graphic_Multi, which means RimWorld expects four directions, but the mod only ever shipped two: south and east. When a direction is absent Graphic_Multi silently falls back to the south texture, so an MSE droid walking AWAY from you turns around and shows you its FRONT. Nothing is logged — "Failed to find any textures at" fires only when every direction of a set is missing, and this set has two.

No defs are patched, no code runs, and Outer Rim - Droid Depot is not altered. This mod drops one loose PNG at the path the donor's own def already asks for.

CONTENTS

  OuterRim/Droid/MSE_north
      The back of the MSE-6 repair droid. 256x256, 1,051 bytes, 8.86% of the
      canvas inked.

      THE DONOR'S ORIGINAL: there is none. Droid Depot ships MSE_south
      (256x256, 2,707 bytes) and MSE_east (256x256, 2,064 bytes) and no north
      texture at any load folder. The absence was confirmed against the 1.6
      AssetBundle rather than against the mod's stale loose folder: the bundle
      manifest lists DroidDepot/Textures/OuterRim/Droid/MSE_east and
      DroidDepot/Textures/OuterRim/Droid/MSE_south and no MSE_north entry, so
      there is nothing to override and nothing to conflict with.

      HOW OURS WAS BUILT AND VERIFIED: the silhouette and the black keyline are
      copied PIXEL-FOR-PIXEL from the donor's own MSE_south, so registration,
      canvas, bounding box (97, 80, 159, 178) and 3 px keyline weight are exact
      by construction and cannot drift. Only the interior is re-authored — the
      front bevel is replaced by a plain rear panel with a horizontal vent seam
      and two vertical panel joints, using the donor's own measured greys
      (upper plate 231, lower panel 178, vent seam 96, panel joints 148), which
      is what the back of a box droid should read as. The generator is shipped
      in Source/draw_mse_north.py.

WHERE THE DEF IS

Outer Rim - Droid Depot's own PawnKindDef asks for a four-way graphic:

  1.6/Defs/ThingDefs_Automatons/Animal/Droid_MSEDroid.xml
    line 81  defName        OuterRim_MSEDroid
    line 89  texPath        OuterRim/Droid/MSE
    line 90  graphicClass   Graphic_Multi
    line 113 recipeIcon     OuterRim/Droid/MSE_south

NO LOAD ORDER REQUIREMENT — AND THAT IS DELIBERATE

This mod deliberately declares no loadAfter, because it does not need one.

On 1.6 Outer Rim - Droid Depot serves its art from an AssetBundle, not from
loose files. Its LoadFolders.xml swaps the v1.4/v1.5 "Common_Old" folder for

AssetBundles/neronix17_outerrim_droiddepot. The loose droid PNGs still sitting
in Common_Old are not loaded on this game version.

game resources, then AssetBundles — so a loose PNG beats a bundled asset
regardless of which mod loads first. In this particular case the point is
academic twice over, since the bundle contains no north texture to be beaten.

win by being loose, so unsubscribe it at that point.
